decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The changelog [ev-d77c45bb6b3f] and the linked PR [ev-8923aacaf9e4] say the circuit-breaker response-code option, introduced in PR #10147, was missing from the Kubernetes CRD and is now added so it can be used with CRDs. The changed files [ev-0e685b43081f] (pkg/provider/kubernetes/crd/traefikio/v1alpha1/middleware.go, traefik.io_middlewares.yaml, the CRD definition) narrow the subject to the circuitBreaker spec of the traefik.io/v1alpha1 Middleware CRD. So the change is an added field, and only kubernetes-crd provider users who configure a circuitBreaker Middleware are exposed. The evidence never gives the exact field key or its default, so the field path is inferred from the changed files rather than stated, and confidence is low.
